scenes.line1: Are all pods managed the same?
scenes.say: Not every Kubernetes workload is a deployment. Which controller should you use for your app?

scenes.label: Deployment
scenes.say: Deployments are for stateless apps. Pods can be swapped out at any time.

left.title: StatefulSet
items: Each pod gets its own storage

scenes.say: StatefulSets are for apps like databases, where each pod needs a unique name and its own storage. DaemonSets make sure there's one pod on every node, perfect for things like log collectors.
Jobs handle one-time tasks, like database migrations. CronJobs run those tasks on a schedule, like nightly reports.

scenes.question: Which for a log agent on all nodes?
scenes.right: Use a DaemonSet so every node gets a pod.
scenes.say: Here's a classic interview trap. If you need a log agent running everywhere, don't use a deployment. Pick a DaemonSet so every node gets a pod.
